name: 写作节奏分析
description: 分析 writing cadence and rhythm 模式.
useCase: 通过节拍器式的规律性检测AI文本
mechanism: 计算 auto相关性 of row energy 以检测 periodic 模式. AI text shows metronomic regularity, while 人类写作 has natural cadence variations.
source: Tay et al. (2020) - Comparative Study of Human vs. Machine Generated Text
parameters: 窗口大小: 自适应, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: 熵, CV, 相关性
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI生成的 text
- Language-agnostic 统计 approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger 误报
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies 跨 写作风格s

references.title: Tay et al. (2020) - Comparative Study of Human vs. Machine Generated Text
Neal, T. et al. (2018). Surveying Stylometry Techniques and Applications. ACM Computing Surveys.
Uchendu, A. et al. (2020). Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation. EMNLP.
